import asyncio,base64,hashlib,inspect,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import yaml,rclpy
from launch import LaunchDescription,LaunchService
from launch.actions import RegisterEventHandler
from launch.event_handlers import OnProcessExit
from launch_ros.actions import Node
from lifecycle_msgs.srv import ChangeState
from rcl_interfaces.srv import GetParameters
from rclpy.parameter import Parameter
from rclpy.qos import QoSProfile,QoSReliabilityPolicy,QoSDurabilityPolicy
from rclpy.serialization import serialize_message,deserialize_message
from nav_msgs.msg import OccupancyGrid
from nav2_msgs.msg import CostmapFilterInfo
from geometry_msgs.msg import TransformStamped
from tf2_msgs.msg import TFMessage
from rosgraph_msgs.msg import Clock
from generate_keepout_lab import generate
from probe_real_nav2_keepout import Observer
from oomwoo_sim_support.keepout_config import build_keepout_overlay,_pgm

async def main():
    out=Path('/tmp/local-rolling-contract');out.mkdir()
    source=Path('/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support')
    metadata=yaml.safe_load((source/'maps/test_room.yaml').read_text())
    sw,sh,source_pixels=_pgm(source/'maps'/metadata['image']);changed=bytearray(source_pixels)
    unknown_indices=(14072,8589)
    for index in unknown_indices:
        row,col=divmod(index,sw);changed[(sh-1-row)*sw+col]=128
    (out/'source.pgm').write_bytes(f'P5\n{sw} {sh}\n255\n'.encode()+changed)
    metadata['image']='source.pgm';source_yaml=out/'source.yaml';source_yaml.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(metadata))
    generate(out,test_room=source_yaml,nav_params=source/'config/nav2_params.yaml')
    original_metadata=yaml.safe_load((out/'keepout_test_room.yaml').read_text())
    ow,oh,original_pixels=_pgm(out/original_metadata['image'])
    original_forbidden=[(oh-1-row)*ow+col for row in range(oh) for col in range(ow) if original_pixels[row*ow+col]==0]
    overlay,count=build_keepout_overlay(source/'config/nav2_params.yaml',source_yaml,out/'keepout_test_room.yaml',output_dir=out)
    config=yaml.safe_load(overlay.read_text())
    config['controller_server']['ros__parameters']['use_sim_time']=True
    params=config['local_costmap']['local_costmap']['ros__parameters'];params['use_sim_time']=True
    assert params['rolling_window'] is True and params['global_frame']=='odom'
    effective=out/'effective.yaml';effective.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config))
    rclpy.init(args=['--ros-args','-r','/valdi/keepout_filter_mask:=/oomwoo/keepout_mask','-r','/valdi/keepout_costmap_filter_info:=/oomwoo/keepout_filter_info'])
    node=Observer();node.set_parameters([Parameter('use_sim_time',value=True)])
    q=QoSProfile(depth=1,reliability=QoSReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE,durability=QoSDurabilityPolicy.TRANSIENT_LOCAL)
    masks=node.create_publisher(OccupancyGrid,'/oomwoo/keepout_mask',q)
    infos=node.create_publisher(CostmapFilterInfo,'/oomwoo/keepout_filter_info',q)
    static=node.create_publisher(TFMessage,'/tf_static',q)
    dynamic=node.create_publisher(TFMessage,'/tf',10)
    clocks=node.create_publisher(Clock,'/clock',10)
    served=Path(config['oomwoo_keepout_mask_server']['ros__parameters']['yaml_filename']);meta=yaml.safe_load(served.read_text());w,h,pixels=_pgm(served.parent/meta['image'])
    mask=OccupancyGrid();mask.header.frame_id='map';mask.header.stamp.sec=1
    mask.info.width=w;mask.info.height=h;mask.info.resolution=meta['resolution'];mask.info.origin.position.x,mask.info.origin.position.y=meta['origin'][:2];mask.info.origin.orientation.w=1.
    mask.data=[100 if pixels[row*w+col]==0 else 0 for row in reversed(range(h)) for col in range(w)]
    mask=deserialize_message(serialize_message(mask),OccupancyGrid)
    assert list(mask.data).count(100)==count==221
    masks.publish(mask)
    info=CostmapFilterInfo();info.type=0;info.filter_mask_topic='/oomwoo/keepout_mask';info.base=0.;info.multiplier=1.;infos.publish(info)
    offset=(.4,-.3,.2);c,s=math.cos(offset[2]),math.sin(offset[2])
    trans=TransformStamped();trans.header.frame_id='map';trans.child_frame_id='odom';trans.header.stamp.sec=1
    trans.transform.translation.x,trans.transform.translation.y=offset[:2];trans.transform.rotation.z=math.sin(offset[2]/2);trans.transform.rotation.w=math.cos(offset[2]/2)
    static.publish(TFMessage(transforms=[trans]))
    pose=TransformStamped();pose.header.frame_id='odom';pose.child_frame_id='base_link';pose.transform.rotation.w=1.
    xy=[-.5,0.]
    processes=[Node(package='nav2_controller',executable='controller_server',name='controller_server',parameters=[str(effective)],output='screen')]
    exits=[]
    handlers=[RegisterEventHandler(OnProcessExit(target_action=p,on_exit=lambda event,context:exits.append(event.returncode) or [])) for p in processes]
    launch=LaunchService();launch.include_launch_description(LaunchDescription(processes+handlers));task=asyncio.create_task(launch.run_async())
    wall=time.monotonic();now=[2_000_000_000]
    result={'ok':False,'scope':'Combined d44050a protected mask and literal KeepoutFilter in installed controller/local rolling costmap; manually supplied map->odom and moving odom->base TF/clock. No Gazebo, scan, plant, hardware, action goal or motor.','effective_local_configuration':params,'map_to_odom':offset,'mask_cells':count,'mask_ros_base64':base64.b64encode(serialize_message(mask)).decode('ascii'),'snapshots':[]}
    async def until(pred,seconds):
        end=time.monotonic()+seconds
        while time.monotonic()<end:
            if task.done():raise RuntimeError('owned launch stopped')
            ns=2_000_000_000+int((time.monotonic()-wall)/.02)*20_000_000;now[0]=ns
            clock=Clock();clock.clock.sec=ns//1_000_000_000;clock.clock.nanosec=ns%1_000_000_000;clocks.publish(clock)
            pose.header.stamp=clock.clock;pose.transform.translation.x,pose.transform.translation.y=xy
            dynamic.publish(TFMessage(transforms=[pose]))
            rclpy.spin_once(node,timeout_sec=0.)
            if pred():return
            await asyncio.sleep(.01)
        raise RuntimeError('observation stage timeout')
    async def transition(ident):
        client=node.create_client(ChangeState,'/controller_server/change_state');await until(client.service_is_ready,20)
        req=ChangeState.Request();req.transition.id=ident;f=client.call_async(req);await until(f.done,25);assert f.result().success,ident
    async def getparams(names):
        client=node.create_client(GetParameters,'/local_costmap/local_costmap/get_parameters');await until(client.service_is_ready,10)
        req=GetParameters.Request();req.names=names;f=client.call_async(req);await until(f.done,10)
        return {n:{'type':v.type,'double':v.double_value,'bool':v.bool_value,'string':v.string_value,'strings':list(v.string_array_value)} for n,v in zip(names,f.result().values)}
    try:
        for ident in (1,3):await transition(ident)
        result['effective_parameters']=await getparams(['global_frame','rolling_window','resolution','filters','plugins','keepout_inflation.plugin','keepout_inflation.inflation.inflation_radius'])
        forbidden=original_forbidden
        bx0=mask.info.origin.position.x+min(i%w for i in forbidden)*mask.info.resolution;bx1=mask.info.origin.position.x+(max(i%w for i in forbidden)+1)*mask.info.resolution
        by0=mask.info.origin.position.y+min(i//w for i in forbidden)*mask.info.resolution;by1=mask.info.origin.position.y+(max(i//w for i in forbidden)+1)*mask.info.resolution
        result['original_mask_bbox']=[bx0,by0,bx1,by1]
        unknown_boxes={}
        for index in unknown_indices:
            col,row=index%w,index//w;left=mask.info.origin.position.x+col*mask.info.resolution;bottom=mask.info.origin.position.y+row*mask.info.resolution
            unknown_boxes[index]=(left,bottom,left+mask.info.resolution,bottom+mask.info.resolution)
        reference_boxes=[(bx0,by0,bx1,by1),unknown_boxes[14072]]
        result['source_unknown_cell_boxes']={str(k):v for k,v in unknown_boxes.items()}

        support=params['keepout_inflation']['inflation']['inflation_radius']+math.sqrt(2)*max(mask.info.resolution,params['resolution'])
        for target in [(-.5,0.),(1.,0.),(3.,0.),(2.,1.8),(4.,1.8),(2.,1.8),(-.5,0.)]:
            xy[:]=target;changed=now[0];stamps=set()
            def settled():
                grid=node.local_grid
                if grid is None or grid.header.frame_id!='odom':return False
                origin=grid.info.origin.position;res=grid.info.resolution
                if abs(origin.x-(target[0]-params['width']/2))>1.1*res or abs(origin.y-(target[1]-params['height']/2))>1.1*res:return False
                ns=grid.header.stamp.sec*1_000_000_000+grid.header.stamp.nanosec
                if ns>changed+200_000_000:stamps.add(ns)
                return len(stamps)>=3
            await until(settled,12)
            grid=node.local_grid;res=grid.info.resolution;origin=grid.info.origin.position
            interior=holes=outside=positive=0;examples=[];unknown_samples={str(index):{'interior':0,'holes':0} for index in unknown_indices}
            for i,v in enumerate(grid.data):
                u=origin.x+(i%grid.info.width+.5)*res;vcoord=origin.y+(i//grid.info.width+.5)*res
                x=offset[0]+c*u-s*vcoord;y=offset[1]+s*u+c*vcoord
                if bx0+res<x<bx1-res and by0+res<y<by1-res:
                    interior+=1;holes+=int(v<95)
                for index,(ux0,uy0,ux1,uy1) in unknown_boxes.items():
                    # Exact inner-cell samples, separated from raster-boundary rounding.
                    if ux0+res*.5<x<ux1-res*.5 and uy0+res*.5<y<uy1-res*.5:
                        unknown_samples[str(index)]['interior']+=1;unknown_samples[str(index)]['holes']+=int(v<95)
                if v>0:
                    positive+=1
                    dist=min(math.hypot(max(left-x,0,x-right),max(bottom-y,0,y-top)) for left,bottom,right,top in reference_boxes)
                    if dist>support:
                        outside+=1
                        if len(examples)<5:examples.append({'map_xy':[x,y],'cost':int(v),'distance_to_served_mask_support_m':dist})
            result['snapshots'].append({'robot_odom_xy':list(target),'origin_xy':[origin.x,origin.y],'resolution':res,'width':grid.info.width,'height':grid.info.height,'stamp_ns':grid.header.stamp.sec*1_000_000_000+grid.header.stamp.nanosec,'distinct_settled_messages':len(stamps),'mask_interior_cells_in_window':interior,'interior_holes':holes,'positive_cells':positive,'far_positive_cells':outside,'allowed_support_m':support,'far_examples':examples,'source_unknown_cells':unknown_samples,'costmap_ros_base64':base64.b64encode(serialize_message(grid)).decode('ascii')})
        assert result['snapshots'][0]['mask_interior_cells_in_window']>0
        assert result['snapshots'][3]['source_unknown_cells']['14072']['interior']>0
        assert result['snapshots'][5]['source_unknown_cells']['14072']['interior']>0
        assert result['snapshots'][4]['positive_cells']==0
        assert all(item['holes']==0 for snap in result['snapshots'] for item in snap['source_unknown_cells'].values())

        result['ok']=all(x['interior_holes']==0 and x['far_positive_cells']==0 for x in result['snapshots'])
        result['source_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(Path(inspect.getfile(build_keepout_overlay)).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert result['source_sha256']=='a194215caba51ce40fc21c22d55ea593007b1e909689ab64100fac99465c1c09'
    except Exception as exc:result['error']=repr(exc)
    finally:
        close=launch.shutdown()
        if inspect.isawaitable(close):await close
        try:await asyncio.wait_for(task,timeout=15)
        except Exception as exc:result['cleanup_error']=repr(exc);result['ok']=False
        result['process_exit_codes']=exits
        if exits!=[0]:result['ok']=False
        result['seconds']=round(time.monotonic()-wall,3)
        result['cgroup']={str(p):p.read_text() for p in [Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak'),Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events'),Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/pids.peak')] if p.exists()}
        node.destroy_node();rclpy.shutdown();print('LOCAL_ROLLING_RESULT '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    return 0 if result['ok'] else 1
raise SystemExit(asyncio.run(main()))
CASE
scope: One existing local-controller fixture extended to derived-mask unknown inside/outside. Seven controlled TF windows, exact original rectangle and isolated-cell references; no Gazebo/physical motor/goal. Not actual plant motion or dynamic map updates.
